pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: The Texas Journeyman Electrician examination is part of the state electrical licensing process. Candidates preparing for this exam should follow the current TDLR application and testing instructions before scheduling. The licensing process may include application review, documentation of qualifying electrical experience or training, examination approval, and final license issuance requirements. The Texas Journeyman Electrician exam is designed to measure whether the candidate understands the electrical knowledge required to work as a licensed journeyman electrician. Journeyman-level testing focuses on practical trade knowledge, code application, safety, wiring methods, calculations, and the ability to apply NEC rules to real installation scenarios. Texas electrical licensing includes several different classifications, so candidates should make sure they are preparing for the correct credential.

pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: A journeyman electrician path is different from an apprentice registration, master electrician license, residential wireman license, maintenance electrician license, sign electrician license, or electrical contractor license. This package is built for Texas Journeyman Electrician exam preparation and broad NEC-based journeyman-level review. Texas journeyman electrician preparation should include the National Electrical Code, electrical theory, practical installation knowledge, conductor sizing, grounding and bonding, services, feeders, branch circuits, motors, transformers, wiring methods, raceways, boxes, overcurrent protection, special occupancies, special equipment, safety, and calculations. Candidates should also be prepared to review Texas-specific electrical rules and licensing responsibilities when those topics are included in the exam materials or application instructions. Electrical calculations are an important part of journeyman-level preparation.

pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: Candidates should practice service load calculations, feeder calculations, branch-circuit calculations, conductor ampacity, conductor adjustment and correction, voltage drop, box fill, raceway fill, motor calculations, transformer calculations, demand factors, neutral loads, continuous loads, and overcurrent protection sizing. Calculation questions can be challenging under time pressure, so repeated practice is a key part of preparation. The 2026 Texas Journeyman Electrician Study Guide helps candidates organize the major content areas they need to review. The 2026 Electrician Calculations Study Guide supports math-heavy topics and helps candidates build step-by-step calculation confidence. pieces.t: Texas Journeyman Electrician exam preparation should include open-book code navigation and reference-use practice. pieces.t: Exam-room reference rules are controlled by the current PSI candidate bulletin and TDLR testing instructions. Candidates should review the official rules before test day to confirm which books and materials are permitted.

pieces.h: Q: Why are NEC tabs helpful?
pieces.t: NEC tabs help candidates locate major articles, chapters, tables, and subject areas faster during study. This supports stronger code-navigation practice and helps candidates become more comfortable using the NEC as a reference.

pieces.h: Q: Does this package include calculation practice?
pieces.t: Yes. The 2026 Electrician Calculations Study Guide is included to help candidates review calculation topics that commonly appear on master electrician exams.

pieces.h: Q: Does a Texas Master Electrician license automatically equal an Electrical Contractor license?
pieces.t: No. A Texas Master Electrician license is an individual license. Electrical contracting activity may also require a licensed Electrical Contractor business, depending on the work being offered or performed.

pieces.h: Q: Should I study Texas laws and rules in addition to the NEC?
pieces.t: Yes. Candidates should review Texas electrical laws, TDLR rules, licensing requirements, supervision responsibilities, and any state-specific subjects listed in the current examination instructions.

pieces.h: Q: Does this package guarantee that I will pass?
pieces.t: No. This package is designed to support preparation through organized study materials, code review, calculations practice, flash cards, online questions, and structured study guidance. Exam results depend on the candidate’s preparation, knowledge, and performance.

pieces.h: Q: Should I confirm Texas licensing requirements before testing?
pieces.t: Yes. Candidates should confirm the required license classification, eligibility requirements, application process, code edition, reference rules, and post-exam licensing steps before scheduling or taking an exam.

pieces.h: Q: Is this combo based on the 2026 NEC?
pieces.t: Yes. This combo is based on the 2026 National Electrical Code and includes the National Electrical Code 2026 Paperback.

pieces.h: Q: What books are included in this package?
pieces.t: This package includes the 2026 Texas Master Electrician Study Guide, the 2026 Electrician Calculations Study Guide, and the National Electrical Code 2026 Paperback.

pieces.h: Q: Who should use this Texas master electrician combo?
pieces.t: This combo is intended for electricians preparing for the Texas Master Electrician exam, NEC-based open-book code navigation, Texas electrical licensing topics, and electrical calculation exam content.

pieces.h: Q: Who administers Texas electrical licensing?
pieces.t: Texas electrical licensing is administered through the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation.

pieces.h: Q: Who provides Texas electrician exams?
pieces.t: PSI provides examination services for Texas electrician candidates who have received eligibility approval through TDLR.

pieces.h: Q: Is a Texas Master Electrician license the same as an Electrical Contractor license?
pieces.t: No. The Texas Master Electrician license is an individual license. The Electrical Contractor license is a separate business-related license category with its own requirements.

pieces.h: Q: Does this package help with electrical calculations?
pieces.t: Yes. The 2026 Electrician Calculations Study Guide is included to help candidates practice formulas, NEC table use, load calculations, conductor sizing, raceway fill, box fill, service calculations, and other calculation-based topics.

pieces.h: Q: Can I study directly from the NEC with this package?
pieces.t: Yes. The National Electrical Code 2026 Paperback is included so candidates can study article language, definitions, tables, exceptions, and code requirements directly.

pieces.h: Exam Room Approved Books
pieces.t:
National Electrical Code, 2023 Edition
The current Texas PSI candidate bulletin lists the National Electrical Code, 2023 Edition, as the allowed examination reference. Candidates are responsible for bringing their own compliant soft-bound NEC book to the examination site.

pieces.h: Q: Who is this Texas Master Electrician exam prep combo for?
pieces.t: This combo is for electricians preparing for the Texas Master Electrician licensing exam administered through PSI after approval by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation.

pieces.h: Q: Is this product based on the 2026 National Electrical Code?
pieces.t: Yes. This product is based on the 2026 National Electrical Code and is designed to support NEC-focused electrical exam preparation.

pieces.h: Q: Who regulates Texas Master Electrician licensing?
pieces.t: Texas Master Electrician licensing is regulated by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation.

pieces.h: Q: Who administers the Texas Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: PSI administers the Texas Master Electrician examination after TDLR approves the candidate’s eligibility.

pieces.h: Q: How many portions are on the Texas Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The Texas Master Electrician exam has two portions: the NEC Knowledge Portion and the Calculations Portion. Candidates must pass each portion with a minimum score of 70%.

pieces.h: Q: How many questions are on the Texas Master Electrician NEC Knowledge Portion?
pieces.t: The NEC Knowledge Portion contains 75 items, including 5 non-scored items, and allows 150 minutes.

pieces.h: Q: How many questions are on the Texas Master Electrician Calculations Portion?
pieces.t: The Calculations Portion contains 33 items, including 3 non-scored items, and allows 170 minutes.

pieces.h: Q: What score is required to pass the Texas Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Each portion of the Texas Master Electrician examination requires a minimum score of 70% to pass.

pieces.h: Q: What book is allowed for the Texas Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The National Electrical Code is allowed in the examination room. Candidates must bring a compliant soft-bound NEC book. Loose-leaf, spiral-bound, and ring-bound copies are not allowed, and the NEC Handbook is not allowed.

pieces.h: Q: Can I write in my NEC book during the Texas exam?
pieces.t: No. Candidates may not write, highlight, underline, index, or mark the NEC book during the examination session. Notes, highlighting, and underlining must be completed before the exam and must comply with PSI rules.

pieces.h: Q: Does this product include practice exams?
pieces.t: Yes. This package includes 12 practice exams plus 2 full final exams. The practice exams help you build familiarity with exam-style questions, while the final exams help you evaluate readiness after completing more of your study plan.

pieces.h: Q: Are flash cards included?
pieces.t: Yes. This is a study guide and flash card combo. The flash cards are designed to help reinforce electrical terms, formulas, definitions, NEC concepts, Texas master exam topics, calculations, and exam-style recall.

pieces.h: Q: Does this combo guarantee that I will pass the exam?
pieces.t: No. This product is designed to support preparation through structured study, practice exams, final exams, flash card review, reference navigation, and NEC-based preparation. Exam results and licensing approval depend on the candidate’s preparation, testing performance, and Texas licensing requirements.
